title: ATO Publishes Four-Section CGDMTR Lodgment Instructions Covering Entity Disclosure, GIR Cross-Reference and Return-Locking Rules
summary: The ATO released detailed lodgment instructions (guidance dated 4 August, published 14 August 2026) for the Combined Global and Domestic Minimum Tax Return, covering lodging-entity identification, disclosure of all covered group entities and top-up tax amounts, cross-reference to where the GIR was filed, and a final lodgment-summary step after which the return locks and can only be changed via formal amendment. Groups lodging for more than 20 entities cannot use ATO online services and must use approved third-party software instead.
razer_relevance: MOL AccessPortal Pty Ltd (MOL008) is a CGDMTR filer; confirm now whether ATO online services suffice or third-party software is required, and note the return locks on submission with only formal amendment available afterward.

title: Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC Consolidates Tax Administration Guidance — Compliance, Refunds, Treaty Relief and Audit Procedures
summary: Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC, implementing Vietnam's 2025 Tax Administration Law and Decree 252, was published 7 August 2026 (effective from 1 July 2026) and consolidates guidance on tax compliance management, tax refunds, tax treaty relief, allocation of tax liabilities, and tax audit procedures, replacing prior piecemeal guidance in these areas.
razer_relevance: THS Game JSC should review the treaty-relief and tax-audit procedure sections against its current FCT/WHT positions on cross-border payments to Razer group entities, since this circular replaces guidance BDO Vietnam has been relying on.

title: LHDN Enforces Stricter TIN/BRN Validation and New SVDP Document Versions in MyInvois from 1 August 2026
summary: From 1 August 2026, LHDN's Validate Taxpayer's TIN API began validating Tax Identification Number and Business Registration Number together — a mismatch between a buyer's BRN and HASiL records now blocks e-invoice issuance. LHDN also introduced SVDP 1.2/1.3 document versions exclusively for a Special Voluntary Disclosure Programme window running through 31 December 2027.
razer_relevance: RMS Reloads Sdn Bhd should audit buyer master data (12-digit SSM-format BRNs, no scientific-notation amount fields, correct use of State Code 17) before this date to avoid e-invoice submission failures and resulting payment delays.

title: Indonesia Replaces 2014 Tax Representative Rules with PMK-44/2026: New Competency Standards and Digital Authorization
summary: PMK-44/2026, effective 6 July 2026 and covered by KPMG Indonesia's August 2026 tax news flash, replaces the decade-old PMK-229/2014 framework governing who may represent a taxpayer before Indonesian tax authorities. It introduces enhanced competency requirements for representatives, expands the categories of eligible representatives, formalizes digital authorization procedures, and tightens governance over taxpayer representation generally.
razer_relevance: PT MOL AccessPortal should confirm its current tax representatives (internal staff or external advisers handling DGT/Coretax matters) meet the new competency and digital-authorization requirements before relying on existing authorizations.

title: IRAS Updates Major Exporter Scheme e-Tax Guide and Property-Owner GST Guidance on Nominee Clauses
summary: IRAS released the 18th edition of the Major Exporter Scheme (MES) e-Tax Guide on 3 August 2026, and updated GST guidance for property owners and holding companies on 7 August 2026, clarifying GST treatment and input tax implications for options to purchase involving a nominee clause.
razer_relevance: Limited direct relevance unless RMS Managed Services or Razer Online Pte Ltd use the MES for import GST suspension, or hold Singapore property via a nominee arrangement — worth a quick check with the local finance team rather than assuming it doesn't apply.
